concept: Passing on genuine care for the natural world to children or younger people, through practice rather than lecture
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic family scenario where an adult wants to instill environmental care in a child, but lecturing alone hasn't landed
exercise.reflection_prompt: What shared, hands-on experience might teach this better than words?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific shared outdoor or environmental activity to do together

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific, real shared activity rather than a plan to explain values verbally
